{{Top|leg}}
A '''pit-boar''' was a creature whose teeth decorated the half-mask worn by [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] while in disguise as a [[Skiff guard/Legends|skiff guard]] in [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]] during the rescue attempt of [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].<ref name="ROTJ Novel">[[Star Wars: Return of the Jedi (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'' novelization]]</ref>

==Behind the Scenes==
The tusks on Lando's skiff guard disguise were first described as belonging to a pit-boar in the ''Return of the Jedi'' novelization, written by [[James Kahn]] in [[1983]], but were later identified as belonging to a [[Gondar/Legends|gondar]] in ''[[Taster's Choice: The Tale of Jabba's Chef]]'',<ref name="TC: TToJC">{{StoryCite|story=Taster's Choice: The Tale of Jabba's Chef|book=Tales from Jabba's Palace}}</ref> which was published in ''[[Tales from Jabba's Palace]]'' in [[January]] [[1996]].
